Download `Reset-WhatsApp.zip`, unzip it, and move `Reset WhatsApp.app` to `/Applications`.

- Requires an Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or later) running macOS 13 or later. Intel Macs can build from source.
- Grant the app **Full Disk Access** in **System Settings › Privacy & Security › Full Disk Access** before running it. If you are replacing an earlier version, remove the old entry first and add the new app again.
- The app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; macOS may ask you to confirm that you want to open it.
- **Standard Reset** deletes local WhatsApp data. **Full Reset** also deletes `/Applications/WhatsApp.app` and opens the Mac App Store so you can reinstall it.

Resetting is destructive: messages, media, or drafts that have not synchronized may be lost. Chats on your phone are not affected.
